description: Check the LIVE status of an order — real production stage (from the Enfocus Switch print workflow), ready-for-pickup, or shipped with carrier + tracking (from StarShipit, authoritative). Look up a real order by number (e.g. #119581) or a quote/draft by number (e.g. #D776755). Requires the customer's email, which must match the order. Use for 'where is my order', 'track order 12345', 'is my order ready'. Shipped/delivered from StarShipit is final; otherwise the live Switch stage is returned. CODE REQUIRED: needs the customer's email AND a verified identity token. Without a token this tool emails the customer a 6-digit code and returns status need_verification with a verificationId — ask the customer for the code, call vivid_identity_verify, then call this tool again with the token. It shows nothing before that.

email.description: the email the order was placed under (always required)

token.description: identity token from vivid_identity_verify (required to see any details; without it a code is emailed to the customer)

name: vivid_order_status
title: Check order status
